description: Überschwemmungsgebiete Ilmenau Landkreis Lüneburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Location and description of the floodplains for the Ilmenau in the district of Lüneburg. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains Ilmenau district Lüneburg" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Umweltüberwachung, inspireidentifiziert, opendata, Gewässernetz. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
